0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05006_000001_OLDTITANIA
0.description: Who goes there? Are you the one who broke the seal?

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05006_000002_OLDTITANIA
1.description: Ah, so much time lost... So much frolicking and feasting left undone...

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05006_000003_OLDTITANIA
2.description: We must make up for it, we must... Beginning by playing with <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>!

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05006_000110_VAUTHRY
4.description: Are you so determined to die? One last chance, villains: bow down and acknowledge your king. Your god!

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05006_000210_EMETSELCH
6.description: Show me your “vaunted” strength. And I shall expose the lie of your fragmented existence!

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05006_000220_EMETSELCH
7.description: You...you have no power over me!
